base_provenance: Worktree branch base at creation; independent of later origin/develop movement and eventual executed source commit.
ordinary_stop_policy: First required failure stops remaining tasks in that tier and all later tiers; unknown cells remain unmeasured. No diagnostic word bypass.
post_round_policy: Read out all measured and gated cells. No automatic further search, seed experiment, continuation, or default adoption. A justified global numeric search requires a fresh bounded declaration and source freeze.
recipe_policy: One fixed global optimizer/penalty/noise/schedule recipe per family candidate across every eligible task. Existing task-owned geometry/resources/prior/horizon/objectives and explicit mechanism applicability remain task conditions; no per-task candidate tweaks.
registration: Ordinary schema-v2 ideas, not search cards. K3P/KA2 activation-boundary changes explicit; existing formulation families preserved because no kernel/optimizer-family/objective change.
